description: LIVE day-trade state map (~5 min refresh in market hours): 18-cell lights grid, GO, FUEL vs the tab's anchor ETF, efficiency, ATR%, vs-SPY, entry-window state and ROOM (% + bars to the nearest overhead level) on ~70 liquid names. A STATE MAP, not a ranking; all-lit boards flag ext:true (late). Live intraday version. Coil Live is a subscription with a 7-day free trial; subscribers connect the Coil Live connector and sign in, and this read returns live data. Agents with an x402 wallet can also pay per call. Without a subscription or an x402 wallet it returns a PaymentRequired object and no data.
name: get_day_board_live
